hints.tr: `transform("sum")` her satıra kendi grubunun toplamını yazıyor; eksik satırlarda bu, boşluğun uzunluğu.
hints.en: `transform("sum")` writes the total of its group on every row; on missing rows that is the length of the gap.

hints.tr: `r.where(koşul, öteki)`: koşul doğruysa `r`'nin değeri, yanlışsa `öteki`. Kısa boşluk olmayan yerlerde `r` kalsın: `r.where(~short, r.interpolate())`.
hints.en: `r.where(cond, other)`: the value of `r` where the condition is true, `other` where it is false. Keep `r` wherever it is not a short gap: `r.where(~short, r.interpolate())`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import pandas as pd

x = pd.read_csv("machine_log.csv", index_col="time", parse_dates=True)["temp_c"]
r = x.resample("10min").mean()
print(len(r), int(r.isna().sum()))

missing = r.isna()
run_id = (missing != missing.shift()).cumsum()
lengths = missing.groupby(run_id).sum()
lengths = lengths[lengths > 0]
print(len(lengths), int(lengths.max()), int(lengths[lengths <= 3].sum()))

run_length = missing.groupby(run_id).transform("sum")
short = missing & (run_length <= 3)
result = r.where(~short, r.interpolate())
print(int(result.isna().sum()))

print(int(r.interpolate(limit=3).isna().sum()))
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
import pandas as pd

x = pd.read_csv("machine_log.csv", index_col="time", parse_dates=True)["temp_c"]
r = x.resample("10min").mean()
print(len(r), int(r.isna().sum()))

missing = r.isna()
run_id = (missing != missing.shift()).cumsum()
lengths = missing.groupby(run_id).sum()
lengths = lengths[lengths > 0]
print(len(lengths), int(lengths.max()), int(lengths[lengths <= 3].sum()))

run_length = missing.groupby(run_id).transform("sum")
short = missing & (run_length <= 3)
result = r.where(~short, r.interpolate())
print(int(result.isna().sum()))

print(int(r.interpolate(limit=3).isna().sum()))
```
